children: RNS Number : 1159U  Seneca Growth Capital VCT PLC  09 September 2026
Half-year Report
Unaudited Half-year Report for the six months ended 30 June 2026 & Interim Dividends
Seneca Growth Capital VCT Plc (the "Company")
9 September 2026
Half-year end Report
The Company is pleased to report that it has published its unaudited Half-year Report and financial statements for the six months ended 30 June 2026.
The Half-year Report can be downloaded from the Company's website at https://senecavct.co.uk/reports-documents/.

A copy of the Half-year Report will also be submitted shortly to the National Storage Mechanism ("NSM") and will be available for inspection at the NSM, which is situated at: https://www.fca.org.uk/markets/primary-markets/regulatory-disclosures/national-storage-mechanism.

In order to ensure that shareholders receive regular information in respect of their investment in the Company, we intend to continue to provide a shareholder presentation of the interim results as well as a general portfolio update. The details of this year's shareholder update presentation will be made available on our website in due course. Please visit www.senecavct.co.uk to find out more information.
Declaration of Interim Dividends on Ordinary and B Shares

The Directors of the Company are pleased to declare an interim dividend of 1.5 pence per B Share and an interim capital dividend of 4.0 pence per Ordinary Share for the year to 31 December 2026, to be paid on 2 October 2026.
The ex-dividend date is 17 September 2026.
The record date for the dividends is 18 September 2026.
The payment date is 2 October 2026.
